# goslop text fixture — PERF-PY-23 polymorphic encode in hot export loop
lang: python
file: app/export.py
---
def encode_value(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        parts = []
        for key, item in value.items():
            parts.append(str(key))
            parts.append(encode_value(item))
        return "{" + ",".join(parts) + "}"
    return str(value)


def export_records(records):
    payloads = []
    for record in records:
        payloads.append(encode_value(record))
    return payloads
